title: Message 1
originalTitle: 鎧伝サムライトルーパー ”メッセージ”
summary: Message volume 1 includes original art, story introduction, original drawings, settings, and storyboards. It does not explain the opaque story, but prints Touma's long monologue and lists Message-era heights: Touma 178 cm, Ryo 176 cm, Seiji 175 cm, Shin 174 cm, Shu 170 cm.
